cooked: Composition needs a threat model, not just a wallet that can invoke all four protocols. A shared client can also create cross-protocol fingerprints through timing, amount selection, and which UTXOs it routes into each path; combining their liquidity does not automatically combine their anonymity sets. It would help to specify what an observer or coordinator can correlate, then evaluate the proposed flows against that model.
